namespace = feast_default

# Jewish Communities: kosher options added to vanilla events.
# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_build_kosher_overrides.py from the
# installed game; edit the script, not this file. Each event is a verbatim
# vanilla copy plus id_override_priority and one option marked
# "Jewish Communities", so the rest of the vanilla file stays untouched.

# Vanilla: events/activities/feast_activity/main_events/feast_default_events.txt
feast_default.5005 = {
	id_override_priority = 10 # Jewish Communities: outrank vanilla (0)
	type = activity_event
	title = feast_default.5005.t
	desc = feast_default.5005.desc
	theme = feast_activity
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:host
		animation = happiness
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = dancing
	}
	cooldown = { years = 1 }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = local_var:had_5005 }
		scope:activity.activity_host != root
		NOR = {
			has_character_modifier = feast_hearty_diet_modifier
			has_character_modifier = feast_obsessed_with_garum_modifier
		}
		scope:activity.activity_host = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_imprisoned = no
			culture = {
				OR = {
					has_cultural_pillar = heritage_byzantine
					has_cultural_pillar = heritage_arabic
				}
			}
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
	}

	immediate = {
		set_local_variable = {
			name = had_5005
			value = yes
		}
		scope:activity.activity_host = {
			save_scope_as = host
		}
	}

	option = { # I need to eat this regularly!
		name = feast_default.5005.a
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = feast_hearty_diet_modifier
			years = 10
		}
	}

	option = { # Wow, this is incredible, host!
		name = feast_default.5005.b
		add_opinion = {
			target = scope:host
			modifier = compliment_opinion
			opinion = 20
		}
	}

	option = { # I know a fun fact!
		name = feast_default.5005.c
		flavor = feast_default.5005.c.flavor
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = erudite
				has_trait = education_learning_4
				has_trait = education_learning_5
				has_trait = intellect_good_2
				has_trait = intellect_good_3
			}
		}
		trait = erudite
		trait = education_learning_4
		trait = intellect_good_2
		trait = intellect_good_3

		add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
	}

	option = { # Yes, more garum!
		name = feast_default.5005.d
		trigger = { has_trait = gluttonous }
		trait = gluttonous
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = feast_obsessed_with_garum_modifier
			years = 10
		}
	}

	#Jewish Communities: refuse food or wine that is not kosher
	option = {
		name = feast_default.5005.kehillah_kosher

		trigger = {
			is_jewish_character_trigger = yes
			scope:host = { is_jewish_character_trigger = no }
		}

		flavor = feast_default.5005.kehillah_kosher.flavor

		add_piety = miniscule_piety_gain

		stress_and_fulfillment_impact = {
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			cynical = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
			gluttonous = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 150
			ai_value_modifier = {
				ai_zeal = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Vanilla: events/activities/feast_activity/main_events/feast_default_events.txt
feast_default.6510 = {
	id_override_priority = 10 # Jewish Communities: outrank vanilla (0)
	type = activity_event
	title = feast_default.6510.t
	desc = {
		desc = feast_default.6510.desc.intro
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_character_modifier = cat_story_modifier
					has_character_modifier = dog_story_modifier
				}
				desc = feast_default.6510.desc_cat_and_dog
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_character_modifier = cat_story_modifier }
				desc = feast_default.6510.desc.cat
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_character_modifier = dog_story_modifier }
				desc = feast_default.6510.desc.dog
			}
		}
		desc = feast_default.6510.desc.outro
	}
	theme = feast_activity
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = disgust
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = primary_spouse
		animation = drink_goblet
	}

	cooldown = { years = 2 }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_trait = ill }
		any_owned_story = {
			OR = {
				story_type = story_cycle_pet_cat
				story_type = story_cycle_pet_dog
			}
		}
		scope:activity = {
			any_attending_character = {
				this = root.primary_spouse
				feast_default_participant_trigger = yes
				NOT = {
					has_trait = blind
				}
			}
		}
		is_valid_for_east_asian_events_trigger = no
	}

	immediate = {
		primary_spouse = {
			save_scope_as = primary_spouse
		}
	}

	#Intrigue Skill Duel, provide the cat/dog with your food without offending your primary spouse or guests
	option = {
		name = feast_default.6510.a

		duel = {
			skill = intrigue
			target = primary_spouse
			#I sneakily give the pet(s) the food
			50 = {
				compare_modifier = {
					value = scope:duel_value
					multiplier = 3.5
					min = -49
				}
				desc = feast_default.6510.a.tt.success
				send_interface_toast = {
					type = event_toast_effect_good
					title = feast_default.6510.a.tt.success
					left_icon = root
					right_icon = primary_spouse
					reverse_add_opinion = {
						target = primary_spouse
						modifier = pleased_opinion
						opinion = 10
					}

					if = {
						limit = {
							AND = {
								any_owned_story = { story_type = story_cycle_pet_cat }
								any_owned_story = { story_type = story_cycle_pet_dog }
							}
						}
						add_character_modifier = {
							modifier = feast_well_fed_cat_modifier
							years = 5
						}
						add_character_modifier = {
							modifier = feast_well_fed_dog_modifier
							years = 5
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
								any_owned_story = { story_type = story_cycle_pet_cat }
							}
						add_character_modifier = {
							modifier = feast_well_fed_cat_modifier
							years = 5
						}
					}
					else = {
						add_character_modifier = {
							modifier = feast_well_fed_dog_modifier
							years = 5
						}
					}
				}
			}
			#Getting caught while giving the pet food
			50 = {
				compare_modifier = {
					value = scope:duel_value
					min = -49
				}
				desc = feast_default.6510.a.tt.failure
				send_interface_toast = {
					type = event_toast_effect_bad
					title = feast_default.6510.a.tt.failure
					left_icon = root
					right_icon = primary_spouse
					reverse_add_opinion = {
						target = primary_spouse
						modifier = disappointed_opinion
						opinion = -10
					}
					add_character_modifier = {
						modifier = feast_queasy_courtiers_modifier
						years = 5
					}
				}
			}
		}
		stress_and_fulfillment_impact = {
			honest = minor_stress_impact_gain
			deceitful = minor_stress_impact_loss
			gluttonous = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
			ai_value_modifier = {
				ai_honor = -1
				ai_boldness = 1
				ai_sociability = -1
			}
		}
	}

	#Continue to eat your food
	option = {
		name = feast_default.6510.b
		reverse_add_opinion = {
			target = primary_spouse
			modifier = pleased_opinion
			opinion = 10
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				desc = feast_default.6510.b.tt.success
				send_interface_toast = {
					type = event_toast_effect_good
					title = feast_default.6510.b.tt.success
					left_icon = root
					add_character_modifier = {
						modifier = feast_sturdy_stomach_modifier
						years = 5
					}
				}
			}
			50 = {
				desc = feast_default.6510.b.tt.failure
				send_interface_toast = {
					type = event_toast_effect_bad
					title = feast_default.6510.b.tt.failure
					left_icon = root
					contract_disease_effect = {
						DISEASE = ill
						TREATMENT_EVENT = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		stress_and_fulfillment_impact = {
			gregarious = minor_stress_impact_loss
			shy = minor_stress_impact_gain
			temperate = minor_stress_impact_gain
			gluttonous = minor_stress_impact_loss
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
			ai_value_modifier = {
				ai_honor = 1
				ai_boldness = 1
				ai_sociability = 1
			}
		}
	}

	#Don't eat your food (opt out)
	option = {
		name = feast_default.6510.c
		reverse_add_opinion = {
			target = primary_spouse
			modifier = disappointed_opinion
			opinion = -10
		}
		stress_and_fulfillment_impact = {
			temperate = minor_stress_impact_loss
			gluttonous = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
			ai_value_modifier = {
				ai_honor = -1
				ai_boldness = -1
				ai_sociability = -1
			}
		}
	}

	#Jewish Communities: refuse food or wine that is not kosher
	option = {
		name = feast_default.6510.kehillah_kosher

		trigger = {
			is_jewish_character_trigger = yes
			scope:activity.activity_host = { is_jewish_character_trigger = no }
		}

		flavor = feast_default.6510.kehillah_kosher.flavor

		add_piety = miniscule_piety_gain

		stress_and_fulfillment_impact = {
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			cynical = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
			gluttonous = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 150
			ai_value_modifier = {
				ai_zeal = 1
			}
		}
	}
}
